column4: PR #1969: test/fuzz-only fault-injection wrapper (FaultyStorage) around a real storage.Storage — delegates every method unconditionally except the one call chosen to fail/panic per an armed FaultSpec; never bypasses the wrapped backend's own dial/TLS/locking/audit/authz/credential handling, since a faulted call either skips invoking the real method entirely or invokes it in full (KindEffectThenError). Zero production callers confirmed by grep — only server/faultops's *_test.go files construct it.
